answer: Each identity claims one basalt chamber, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch a lantern opens a silence window; the identity files its whisper peak. An auditor replays the sealed tape against the basalt quiet table; peak over the limit, reused serial, or key mismatch burns the bond. First costs 36, the kth 36+5(k-1), the 1000th 5031; 1,000 fakes pay 2,533,500 plus 70,000 locked; fees follow claim order. A rented-silence ring fails: a borrowed tape carries another key and window stamps, which replay exposes, burning both bonds. An honest operator pays 36 once, bond returned after a clean epoch.
